notes: v1.19 (internal build 39) - everything from the web edition, same-to-same: the three themes (blue, purple, orange) now cover the whole app - page, cards, tables, inputs, bottom nav, pills and buttons - while meaning colours (surplus green, deficit red, Funds amber) stay fixed; the Budget Plan view is now Expense-only, listing your Expense categories in List order with Fixed first then Lifestyle, a no-plan row with its year's spend and a Set Plan button for each category without a plan, plus a Total Planned / Spent / Remaining strip; on the List page each category card can be moved up or down with arrow buttons and keeps its colour when moved, and Fixed Expense categories always stay above Lifestyle ones wherever categories are listed; adding or renaming a category that already exists (even with different capital letters) is now refused instead of duplicating it; the Budget year can now be picked freely (2020-2035) so you can plan 2027 while the book still holds only 2026; accounts no longer refuse a duplicate name - one name may have many accounts, and only a duplicate account number or IBAN is refused, with each same-name account fully separate so editing or deleting one leaves the other alone; the Admin can now hold a user's app updates until released, and a held update shows no prompt at all. The installer now warns you if the app is still running and asks you to close it before installing. Your records are never touched by updates: the book format only grows, merges instead of replacing, and records you delete never come back.
